what: Draws 33 horizontal lines across the pane height (70px left empty top and bottom), each joined by quadratic curves through 21 nodes. Nodes within a 100px square around a point offset 50px up-left from the cursor are pushed outward by (100 − distance) and pulled back by distance from rest × .2. The two are summed, multiplied by .9 and clamped to ±15px per frame, so the lines bend and straighten like waves. Lines are 2px in text color. When the cursor moves away and everything settles, drawing pauses. A striped pane under the footer wordmark.

options.lines: Cells between lines (number of lines is cells + 1), default 32
options.points: Number of segment cells per line (segments are +1), default 20
options.radius: Radius of the pushing square (px), default 100
options.pad: Top and bottom clear height (px), default 70
options.spring: Pull-back ratio to home position, default .2
options.damp: Damping multiplied to the push and pull total, default .9
options.offset: Distance (px) the push center is offset up and left from the cursor, default 50 — 0 puts it right under the cursor
options.from: Below this width (px) only lines are drawn and hover response is off, default 0 (the original uses 30 1px lines instead of the canvas below 1280)

note: The original computes per frame (assuming 60Hz). Here it is divided into 16.7ms steps so the speed is the same on 120Hz screens. With touch or reduced motion, only straight lines are drawn.

from.where: shared.js footer line panel (.sa-footer__field) — original footer canvas#footer-lines (622px, 1280 and up)
